body:
# Rhéā: the restoration, the temple, and the world it opens
Every name in this series was once flattened to fit a keyboard. **Rhéā** is what the evidence put back.

Rhéā's myth is the hinge between Titanic and Olympian rule. She endures Kronos's violence, then engineers the survival of the son who will overthrow him. Kronos, warned that one of his children would overthrow him, swallowed each infant as Rhea bore them.  Rhea wept but was powerless until the birth of Zeus.

That is the figure this file is about — and the temple now standing at its restored name.
## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Rhéā
- **ASCII form:** rhea
- **Meaning:** "Flow, ease (from ῥέω)"
- **Domain of influence:** Motherhood, Fertility, Titans
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Classification:** Tier 1
- **Original script:** Ῥέα
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 209 of 271
## The Name Before the Marks

The name is attested as **Ῥέα**. On the evidence, it means "Flow, ease (from ῥέω)".

Strip **Rhéā** to *rhea* and 2 pieces of evidence vanish:

- **e → é** — Acute on e: the stress position the ASCII form cannot show.
- **a → ā** — Macron on a: the vowel length the ASCII form cannot show.

A reader who knows the marks hears the name correctly on the first try. A reader who never sees them never gets the chance.
## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Rhéā** lives at [/sites/rhea/](/sites/rhea/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/sites/rhea/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/sites/rhea/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/sites/rhea/patterns/).

The restoration preserves more than the ASCII form can say — stress, length, or a letter the Latin keyboard lost — which places it in Tier-1: mechanically verifiable, information-rich.

Every flagship temple is hand-built to the same standard: the original script displayed with its provenance, the pronunciation reconstructed phoneme by phoneme, the sources named — because a restoration you cannot audit is just a spelling with confidence.
## The Archetype at Work

A temple is also a reading of what this figure *means* — and meanings have addresses in the modern world. The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) maps **Rhéā** to the industries its archetype genuinely resonates with, each match argued, weighted, and open to challenge:

- **Wedding, Family & Maternity** — The mother of the gods; maternity enthroned.
- **Agriculture, Food & Harvest** — Motherhood and fertility of the Titan generation.
- **Music, Arts & Performance** — Her tympanon is the drum of the mountain mysteries; rhythm as rite.

The mapping is conservative on purpose: only resonances that can be argued aloud. The rest of the atlas follows the same rule, industry by industry.
## In the Sacred Texts

The Greek tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Theogony](/texts/theogony/), [Homeric Hymns](/texts/homeric-hymns/), and [Works and Days](/texts/works-and-days/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on, free to read, cross-linked back to the names they mention. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.
## The File Continues

This is one of 271 Restoration Files — a second dispatch from every flagship temple in the fleet. The temple's [first dispatch](/sites/rhea/blog/) tells the founding story of the name; the [blog index](/blog/) holds the whole archive.

Continue the series — previous file: **Rāma** ([read it here](/sites/rama/blog/restoration/)) · next file: **Ṛta** ([read it here](/sites/rta/blog/restoration/)).

*The Restoration Files are written from the same canonical record as the temples themselves: the lexicon, the lore catalog, the pattern atlas, and the cited scholarly sources. If a file ever disagrees with its temple, the temple is right — tell us, and the file will be corrected.*
